It starts with the dough.

Every pie is 14 inches and built on our sourdough crust: light, full of air, with a crunch you can hear and a tang that keeps you reaching for another slice.

We started as a pop-up and catering business. The menu follows the seasons and the farmers market.

    From the oven

    Our story

    1. The pop-up years

      Fox Pizza began as a pop-up and catering business, serving sourdough pizza around the Bay Area with rotating seasonal pies.

    2. A new home in Novato

      Owners Anna and Jeff Fox found a spot at 528 Alameda del Prado and built it out as a restaurant.

    3. Doors open

      Sourdough pies, a salad, natural wine, local beer, and a takeout window. A tiny kitchen, so we cook in small batches.
